title: Improper limitation of pathname in the Ad Hoc Transfer component of Progress Software WS_FTP Server versions prior to…
description: A path traversal vulnerability exists in the Ad Hoc Transfer component of Progress Software WS_FTP Server on Windows versions prior to 2024.0.6 and 2025.0.3. This flaw allows an authenticated user to access files outside the intended directories, potentially exposing sensitive information. The vulnerability has a high severity rating with a CVSS score of 7.7.
